correctness.rationale: For cubic pairs F=(F0,F1) in W=Hom(Sym^3 Q²,Q²), rho(g)F(v)=det(g)^(-1)g^(-1)F(gv) is scalar-independent for GL2 lift g (weight -2-1+3=0); hence an honest linear PGL2-representation with projectivization conjugacy of degree-three rational maps. For any nonsplit Q-conic torsor T_C, twist W to W_C, an eight-dimensional vector space over Q by Galois descent. The nonzero-resultant, trivial-geometric-automorphism open U_C is geometrically nonempty: generic cubic maps have trivial centralizer; the explicit Hamilton example has resultant 675, fixed-point discriminant 27760 and distinct fixed multipliers; independently recalculated with exact SymPy arithmetic. Geometric map U_C→M3 is dominant. Q-points of nonempty open in A8 are Zariski dense; trivial Aut forces uniqueness of any geometric dynamical isomorphism, so a P1_Q representative would descend an isomorphism P1→C and split nonsplit C. Thus every prescribed nonsplit class is exactly realized densely, with no height density claim.
